title: WebDesk Growth Dashboard — Project Profile Schema Extension
description: CORRECTED per external verification review (2026-08-05): this file no longer claims JSON Schema `allOf` + `$ref` composition against the base skill's canonical _contracts/project-json.schema.json. That approach was tried in the prior version of this file and is WRONG — `allOf` is an intersection of constraints, not an override, so an instance still had to satisfy the base schema's restrictive enums (host_target, tech_stack.storage) even after this file's own `properties` declared wider values, and `templates/project.json.example` failed validation as a result (6 errors, confirmed by an external reviewer and reproduced here). This file now has two parts, used by ../tools/validate-project-profile.py: (1) `new_field_schemas` — standalone, self-contained schemas for the fields this project adds that the base schema has never heard of (project.project_profile, vercel_execution) — these validate on their own, no $ref needed. (2) `base_schema_patches` — a machine-readable list of patch operations the validator script applies to an IN-MEMORY DEEP COPY of the base schema before validating a project.json instance against it. The base schema file itself (_contracts/project-json.schema.json) is never read-modified-written; only a runtime copy is patched, once per validation run. No network access, no $ref resolution, and no schema-composition trick is used or claimed anywhere in this file.

project.project_profile.description: Selects this profile. This field alone does NOT cause the base orchestrator to auto-load anything — see knowledge/00-scope-and-precedence.md and SKILL.md §2 for the actual (CLAUDE.md-based) V1 loading mechanism. The base orchestrator does not currently read or act on this field; the schema-level check here only confirms the value is well-formed.

vercel_execution.description: Project-local, top-level block (not in the base schema at all) recording the resolved serverless execution model per knowledge/04-serverless-queues-workflows-and-cron.md. This is the actual source of truth for this project's job architecture — tech_stack.queue (patched below to 'vercel-native') exists only so the base schema's tech_stack.queue field has a truthful value; the operational detail lives here.

host_target.description: Must equal project.host_target once the base_schema_patches below extend that enum with 'vercel'. Kept as a separate, redundant field here (rather than only patching project.host_target) so this block is self-checking even if read in isolation.

job_execution_model.description: Resolved per knowledge/04 — dashboard-worker is not a permanent Node.js process or container. This value must never be anything else for this project without a superseding approved decision (see knowledge/00-scope-and-precedence.md's precedence rules).

postgres_marketplace_provider.description: The exact Vercel Marketplace Postgres provider, recorded once provisioned. Null until then. Must never be 'neon' per WDS-002 — see knowledge/01-approved-architecture.md's stop-condition if no qualifying non-Neon East Coast option exists.

base_schema_patches.reason: 01_Dashboard_Master_Specification.md §5 — Vercel Pro is the approved host target. Not in the base enum (local|aws|gcp|cloudflare|heroku|vps).

Selects this profile. See new_field_schemas above for the actual schema (this patch op copies it in verbatim; '$ref_new_field' is a same-file lookup key resolved by the validator script, not a JSON Schema $ref).
Every project.json under this profile must declare it, so an agent never has to guess whether the profile applies.
08_API_and_Integration_Contracts.md §7 — private Vercel Blob is the approved object storage. Not in the base enum (s3|cloudinary|gcs|none).

Corrects the prior version of this file, which forced tech_stack.queue to the base enum's 'none' as a workaround. 'none' was inaccurate — this project DOES use a queue/job system, just not node-cron or BullMQ. 'vercel-native' is the accurate, honest value: Vercel Queues/Workflows/Cron Jobs, detailed in the vercel_execution block. Not in the base enum (node-cron|bullmq|none).
New top-level block, no base-schema equivalent. See new_field_schemas above.
This project's job-execution model is architecturally load-bearing (knowledge/04) — every project.json instance under this profile must record it, not leave it implicit in tech_stack.queue.
